run_dlrm_training: run the DLRM PyTorch model training with argparse CLI flags for architecture, data, and GPU options
run_dlrm_inference: run inference-only mode on a trained DLRM model using --inference-only and --load-model flags
create_dlrm_model: create a DLRM_Net model instance with configurable MLP layers, embedding tables, and interaction operators
create_mlp_layers: create MLP layers with configurable layer sizes and optional sigmoid activation using DLRM_Net.create_mlp
create_embedding_tables: create embedding bag tables with optional QR or MD tricks using DLRM_Net.create_emb
test_dlrm_forward: test the DLRM forward pass with dense features and sparse index offsets and indices
test_distributed_forward: test the distributed forward pass that splits embedding lookups across ranks with all-to-all
test_parallel_forward: test the multi-GPU parallel forward pass with data and model parallelism across devices
review_interact_features: review the interact_features method supporting dot product and concatenation interaction operators
review_sequential_forward: review the sequential_forward method that processes dense and sparse features through bottom MLP, embeddings, and top MLP
export_dlrm_onnx: export the trained DLRM model to ONNX format using the --save-onnx CLI flag
save_dlrm_model: save the DLRM model state dict, optimizer state, and training metrics using --save-model flag
load_dlrm_model: load a previously saved DLRM model checkpoint using --load-model flag for continued training or inference
configure_qr_embedding: configure quotient-remainder trick embeddings using --qr-flag with operation, collisions, and threshold parameters
configure_md_embedding: configure mixed-dimension embeddings using --md-flag with temperature and dimension rounding parameters
